# 1. Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
library(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)
library(Signac)
library(Seurat)
library(future)
library(Matrix)
library(HDF5Array)

library(GenomeInfoDb)})

plan("multicore", workers = 4)

SCRIPT_DIR <- getwd()   
PROJECT_ROOT <- file.path(SCRIPT_DIR, "..")

EQTL_DIR  <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "eqtl_files")
dir.create(EQTL_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# 3. eQTL
## Download eQTL's
```{r}
cell_types_eqtl <- c("Ast", "End", "Ext", "IN", "MG", "OD", "OPC")  
base_url <- "https://zenodo.org/records/14908182/files"
files <- paste0(cell_types_eqtl, "_eqtl_full_assoc.tsv.gz")

options(timeout = max(300, getOption("timeout")))
for (f in files) {
  dest <- file.path(EQTL_DIR, f)
  if (!file.exists(dest)) {
    url <- paste0(base_url, "/", f, "?download=1")
    message("Downloading ", f, " ...")
    try(download.file(url, destfile = dest, mode = "wb"))
  }
}
```

## Candidate Links
```{r}
# Peaks
peaks <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_DIR, "consensus_peak_set.rds"))
GenomeInfoDb::seqlevelsStyle(peaks) <- "UCSC"
peaks <- GenomeInfoDb::keepStandardChromosomes(peaks, pruning.mode = "coarse")

# work only on chr1–3
peaks <- peaks[as.character(seqnames(peaks)) %in% c("chr1","chr2","chr3")]

# Peak midpoints & IDs 
peak_centers <- GenomicRanges::resize(peaks, width = 1, fix = "center")
peak_centers$peak_id <- paste0(as.character(seqnames(peak_centers)), ":", start(peak_centers))

# ±500 kb windows around peak centers
peak_window <- GenomicRanges::resize(peak_centers, width = 1e6 + 1, fix = "center")

# Protein-coding TSS (one per gene)
ensdb <- EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86
genes_db <- genes(ensdb, filter = ~ gene_biotype == "protein_coding")

# Define canonical TSS per gene (choose min coordinate for '+' strand, max for '-' strand)
tss_pos <- ifelse(strand(genes_db) == "+", start(genes_db), end(genes_db))
tss <- GRanges(
  seqnames = seqnames(genes_db),
  ranges   = IRanges(start = tss_pos, width = 1),
  strand   = strand(genes_db),
  gene_id  = genes_db$gene_id
)

GenomeInfoDb::seqlevelsStyle(tss) <- "UCSC"
tss <- GenomeInfoDb::keepStandardChromosomes(tss, pruning.mode = "coarse")

dt <- data.table::as.data.table(tss)
# choose most upstream per gene: min(start) for '+', max(start) for '-'
dt[, key := ifelse(as.character(strand) == "+", start, -start)]
tss_one_dt <- dt[order(gene_id, key), .SD[1], by = gene_id]

tss <- GRanges(tss_one_dt$seqnames,
               IRanges(start = tss_one_dt$start, width = 1),
               strand  = tss_one_dt$strand,
               gene_id = tss_one_dt$gene_id)

# Harmonize seqlevels between peak_window and tss
common_seq <- intersect(seqlevels(peak_window), seqlevels(tss))
peak_window <- GenomeInfoDb::keepSeqlevels(peak_window, common_seq, pruning.mode = "coarse")
tss         <- GenomeInfoDb::keepSeqlevels(tss,         common_seq, pruning.mode = "coarse")

# Overlaps: any TSS within ±500 kb of a peak center
hits <- GenomicRanges::findOverlaps(peak_window, tss, ignore.strand = TRUE)

candidates <- data.table::data.table(
  peak_id = peak_window$peak_id[S4Vectors::queryHits(hits)],
  gene_id = tss$gene_id[S4Vectors::subjectHits(hits)]
)

# De-duplicate pairs, ensure chr1–3 only 
candidates <- unique(candidates)
candidates <- candidates[grepl("^chr[123]:", peak_id)]

# Save compressed and report
out <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "candidate_peak_gene_pairs_chr123.tsv")
data.table::fwrite(candidates, out, sep = "\t")
message("Saved ", nrow(candidates), " candidate peak–gene pairs (chr1–3) to: ", out)

```


## Labeling
```{r}
label_snppg_pairs <- function(
  cell_type,
  candidate_file       = file.path(DATA_DIR, "candidate_peak_gene_pairs_chr123.tsv"),
  eqtl_dir             = EQTL_DIR,
  consensus_peaks_file = file.path(DATA_DIR, "consensus_peak_set.rds"),
  output_file          = NULL,
  pos_cutoff    = 1e-6,
  neg_cutoff    = 0.4,
  power_cutoff  = 0.01
) {
  message("Generating SNP–peak–gene labels for: ", cell_type)

  eqtl_path <- file.path(eqtl_dir, paste0(cell_type, "_eqtl_full_assoc.tsv.gz"))
  if (!file.exists(eqtl_path)) {
    message("  → Skipping ", cell_type, " (missing: ", basename(eqtl_path), ")")
    return(NULL)
  }
  if (is.null(output_file)) {
    output_file <- file.path(eqtl_dir, paste0("training_data_snppg_", cell_type, "_chr123.tsv.gz"))
  }

  # candidates (peak_id = chr:mid ; gene_id = ENSG)
  cand <- data.table::fread(candidate_file)
  stopifnot(all(c("peak_id","gene_id") %in% names(cand)))
  data.table::setkey(cand, peak_id, gene_id)

  # peaks + a lookup to get chr-start-end later
  peaks <- readRDS(consensus_peaks_file)
  GenomeInfoDb::seqlevelsStyle(peaks) <- "UCSC"
  peak_mid  <- start(peaks) + floor((width(peaks) - 1L)/2L)
  LUT_peaks <- data.table(
    peak_id   = paste0(as.character(seqnames(peaks)), ":", peak_mid),
    peak_full = sprintf("%s-%d-%d",
                        as.character(seqnames(peaks)), start(peaks), end(peaks))
  )
  setkey(LUT_peaks, peak_id)

  # eQTLs
  eqtl <- data.table::fread(eqtl_path, select = c("feature","variant_id","Fixed_P","chr","pos"))
  eqtl[, gene_id := sub("\\..*", "", feature)]
  if (!all(grepl("^chr", unique(eqtl$chr)))) eqtl[, chr := paste0("chr", chr)]

  # labels at SNP–gene level
  strong <- eqtl[Fixed_P < power_cutoff]
  eqtl[, label := fifelse(Fixed_P < pos_cutoff, 1L,
                   fifelse(Fixed_P > neg_cutoff &
                           variant_id %in% strong$variant_id &
                           gene_id   %in% strong$gene_id, 2L, 3L))]

  # map SNPs to peaks
  snp_gr <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(seqnames = eqtl$chr,
                                   ranges   = IRanges::IRanges(start = eqtl$pos, width = 1))
  hits <- GenomicRanges::findOverlaps(snp_gr, peaks)

  peak_id_vec <- paste0(
    GenomicRanges::seqnames(peaks)[S4Vectors::subjectHits(hits)], ":",
    GenomicRanges::start  (peaks)[S4Vectors::subjectHits(hits)] +
      floor((GenomicRanges::width(peaks)[S4Vectors::subjectHits(hits)] - 1) / 2)
  )

  snppg <- data.table::data.table(
    variant_id = eqtl$variant_id[S4Vectors::queryHits(hits)],
    chr        = eqtl$chr       [S4Vectors::queryHits(hits)],
    pos        = eqtl$pos       [S4Vectors::queryHits(hits)],
    gene_id    = eqtl$gene_id   [S4Vectors::queryHits(hits)],
    Fixed_P    = eqtl$Fixed_P   [S4Vectors::queryHits(hits)],
    label      = eqtl$label     [S4Vectors::queryHits(hits)],
    peak_id    = peak_id_vec
  )

  # keep only (peak_id, gene_id) within ±500kb universe
  data.table::setkey(snppg, peak_id, gene_id)
  snppg <- snppg[cand, nomatch = 0]

  # add SNP string "chr-(pos-1)-pos"
  snppg[, snp := sprintf("%s-%s-%s", chr, as.integer(pos) - 1L, as.integer(pos))]

  # add celltype
  snppg[, celltype := cell_type]

  # join peak_full -> new column 'peak' (chr-start-end)
  setkey(snppg, peak_id)
  snppg <- LUT_peaks[snppg]
  snppg[, peak := peak_full][, peak_full := NULL]

  # map Ensembl gene_id -> HGNC symbol into new column 'gene'
  sym <- ensembldb::select(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86,
                           keys     = unique(snppg$gene_id),
                           keytype  = "GENEID",
                           columns  = c("SYMBOL","GENEID"))
  sym <- unique(data.table(gene_id = sym$GENEID, gene = sym$SYMBOL))
  setkey(sym, gene_id)
  setkey(snppg, gene_id)
  snppg <- sym[snppg]
  
  missing <- snppg[is.na(gene) | gene == "", unique(gene_id)]
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    message("These gene_ids had no HGNC symbol: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  }
  snppg[is.na(gene) | gene == "", gene := gene_id]

  # final columns 
  out <- snppg[, .(
    snp,
    peak,                 
    peak_id,              
    gene,                 
    gene_id,
    celltype,
    variant_id,
    chr, pos,
    Fixed_P,
    label
  )]

  # sanity
  cnt <- out[, .N, by = label][order(label)]
  message("  Labels: ", paste(sprintf("%d→%d", cnt$label, cnt$N), collapse = ", "))

  data.table::fwrite(out, output_file, sep = "\t")
  message("  → Saved: ", output_file, " (n = ", nrow(out), ")")
  invisible(out)
}

```

## Label all available cell types + subset PeakMatrix per type (label 1/2)
```{r}
# One combined training file with all cell types 
cell_types_run <- c("OD","OPC","Ast","IN","Ext","MG","End")

all_snppg <- list()
for (ct in cell_types_run) {
  res <- label_snppg_pairs(
    cell_type            = ct,
    candidate_file       = file.path(DATA_DIR, "candidate_peak_gene_pairs_chr123.tsv"),
    eqtl_dir             = EQTL_DIR,
    consensus_peaks_file = file.path(DATA_DIR, "consensus_peak_set.rds"),
    output_file          = file.path(EQTL_DIR, paste0("training_data_snppg_", ct, "_chr123.tsv.gz"))
  )
  if (!is.null(res)) all_snppg[[ct]] <- res[]
}

training_all <- data.table::rbindlist(all_snppg, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
out_all <- file.path(EQTL_DIR, "training_data_snppg_ALL_chr123.tsv.gz")
data.table::fwrite(training_all, out_all, sep = "\t")
message("→ Saved combined training file: ", out_all,
        " (n = ", nrow(training_all), ")")
```

# 4. Subset PeakMatrix

```{r}
# Create one chr1–3 PeakMatrix file
consensus_peaks <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_DIR, "consensus_peak_set.rds"))
GenomeInfoDb::seqlevelsStyle(consensus_peaks) <- "UCSC"

# chr1–3 index 
chr_idx <- which(as.character(seqnames(consensus_peaks)) %in% c("chr1","chr2","chr3"))
stopifnot(length(chr_idx) > 0)
consensus_peaks_chr123 <- consensus_peaks[chr_idx]

# Load full PeakMatrix (rows = peaks)
peak_mat_path <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "peak_matrices", "PeakMatrix-1.h5ads")
pm <- zellkonverter::readH5AD(peak_mat_path, use_hdf5 = TRUE)

#Adapt Peakmatrix start to 1-based
pm_ids <- rownames(pm)
parts <- tstrsplit(pm_ids, "[:-]")   
chr   <- parts[[1]]
start <- as.integer(parts[[2]]) + 1  # convert to 1-based
end   <- as.integer(parts[[3]])

rownames(pm) <- paste0(chr, "-", start, "-", end)

# Build the expected rowname strings from the *chr1–3 peaks*
target_ids <- sprintf("%s-%d-%d",
                      as.character(seqnames(consensus_peaks_chr123)),
                      start(consensus_peaks_chr123),
                      end(consensus_peaks_chr123))

# Match those to H5AD rownames
match_idx <- match(target_ids, rownames(pm))
if (anyNA(match_idx)) {
  na_n <- sum(is.na(match_idx))
  stop("Could not match ", na_n, " chr1–3 consensus peaks to H5AD rows. ",
       "Check that both files use the same peak definitions/naming.")
}

pm_chr <- pm[match_idx, ]

assay_name <- intersect(c("X","counts"), names(assays(pm_chr)))[1]
if (is.na(assay_name)) assay_name <- names(assays(pm_chr))[1]

out_h5ad <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "peak_matrices", "PeakMatrix-1-chr123.h5ad")
zellkonverter::writeH5AD(pm_chr, file = out_h5ad, X_name = assay_name)
message("Wrote full subsetted object to: ", out_h5ad,
        "  (rows=", nrow(pm_chr), ", cols=", ncol(pm_chr), ")")

saveRDS(consensus_peaks_chr123, file.path(DATA_DIR, "consensus_peak_set_chr123.rds"))
message("Saved matching chr1–3 peaks (n=", length(consensus_peaks_chr123), ").")

```
